_comment: All thresholds are measured value minus a margin of about 0.09, from one live run on 2026-11-20 (index of 1,245 chunks, hybrid retrieval, claude-haiku-5-5 generation, JEV judge, 44 answerable and 8 unanswerable questions). Measured: hit@1 = hit@5 = mrr 0.886; answerable_pass_rate 1.0; off_topic_escalation 1.0; answerable_coverage 0.932; unanswerable_escalation 1.0; faithfulness_mean 0.891; answer_relevancy_mean 0.895. One run is a small sample (a single question moves a retrieval metric by 0.023); re-measure after any retrieval, chunking or prompt change. Known retrieval misses (5/44): 'codes allowed' questions route to rule chunks, 'make up' does not trigger the children intent, one ambiguous 'Agent' question.
